cards.name: Carson Sinclair
cards.text:
You may take an additional action during your turn, which can only be used on the below [action] ability.
[action]: Choose another investigator at your location. They immediately take an action as if it were their turn. (Limit once per round for each investigator.)
[elder_sign] effect: +0. Draw 1 card. You may resolve this effect anytime another investigator at your location resolves their [elder_sign] effect.
cards.backText:
Deck Size: 30.
Secondary Class Choice: At deck creation, choose Seeker ([seeker]), Mystic ([mystic]), or Survivor ([survivor]).
Deckbuilding Options: Guardian cards ([guardian]) level 0-5, Neutral cards level 0-5, up to 10 level 0-1 events and/or skills of your chosen secondary class.
Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): 2 copies of "As you wish", Selfless to a Fault, 1 random basic weakness.

cards.name: "As you wish"
cards.text:
Carson Sinclair deck only.
Commit only to a skill test being performed by another investigator.
If this test succeeds, the performing investigator draws 1 card. If this test fails, you draw 1 card.

cards.name: Selfless to a Fault
cards.text:
Revelation - Put Selfless to a Fault into play in your threat area.
Forced - At the end of your turn, if you did not commit at least 1 card to a skill test performed by another investigator this turn: Take 1 horror and shuffle Selfless to a Fault into your deck.

cards.name: Vincent Lee
cards.text:
[reaction] After one of your card effects heals damage from an investigator or an investigator's [[Ally]] asset: Add one of your set-aside On the Mend skills to that investigator's hand.
[elder_sign] effect: +1. You may heal 1 damage from an investigator or [[Ally]] asset at your location.
cards.backText:
Deck Size: 30.
Deckbuilding Options: Seeker cards ([seeker]) level 0-3, Neutral cards level 0-5, cards that "heal damage" level 0-5, up to 15 other Guardian and/or Survivor cards level 0-1 ([guardian] and/or [survivor]).
Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Bonesaw, 1 [per_investigator] copies of On the Mend, Wounded Bystander, 1 random basic weakness.
Additional Setup: You begin each game with 1 [per_investigator] copies of On the Mend set aside, out of play.

cards.name: Bonesaw
cards.text:
Vincent Lee deck only.
[action]: Fight. You get +2 [combat] for this attack. If this attack is successful, you may take 1 damage to deal +1 damage for this attack.
[action]: Heal 5 damage from an investigator at your location. Test [intellect] (4). If you fail, that investigator suffers 1 physical trauma. (Max once per game.)

cards.name: On the Mend
cards.text:
Limit 1 On the Mend in your hand.
Commit only to a test you are performing.
Forced - When On the Mend would be discarded from anywhere: Set it aside, out of play, instead.

cards.name: Wounded Bystander
cards.text:
Revelation - Put Wounded Bystander into play in your play area with 3 damage on it. It cannot leave play while it has damage (unless it is defeated). If it has no damage, discard it.
Forced - When you take non-direct damage: At least 1 of it must be assigned to Wounded Bystander, if able.
Forced - If Wounded Bystander is defeated: You suffer 1 mental trauma.

cards.name: Kymani Jones
cards.text:
[fast]: Engage an exhausted enemy at your location.
[reaction] When you attempt to evade an exhausted non-[[Elite]] enemy: Add your [intellect] to your skill value for this attempt. If you succeed by at least X, discard that enemy. X is that enemy's remaining health.
[elder_sign] effect: +1. If there is an exhausted enemy at your location, you automatically succeed instead.
cards.backText:
Deck Size: 30.
Deckbuilding Options: Rogue cards ([rogue]) level 0-5, [[Tool]] cards level 0-4, Neutral cards level 0-5.
Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Grappling Hook, Agent Fletcher, 1 random basic weakness.
Bonus Experience: You begin the campaign with 5 additional experience (does not affect the number of weaknesses you must take in Standalone Mode).

cards.name: Grappling Hook
cards.text:
Kymani Jones deck only.
Actions performed using Grappling Hook do not provoke attacks of opportunity.
[action][action] Exhaust Grappling Hook: Take up to 3 different basic actions from the following list, in any order (engage, evade, investigate, or move). If you investigate, use your [agility] instead of your [intellect].

cards.name: Agent Fletcher
cards.text:
Alert. Hunter.
Prey - Kymani Jones only.
While Kymani Jones is evading Agent Fletcher, reduce their [intellect] value to 0.

cards.name: Amina Zidane
cards.text:
[reaction] When you play an asset: Reduce its resource cost by 3. It enters play with 1 doom on it. (Limit once per round.)
[elder_sign] effect: +2. You may move all doom from a card at your location to another card at your location.
cards.backText:
Deck Size: 30.
Deckbuilding Options: Mystic cards ([mystic]) level 0-5, Neutral cards level 0-5, [[Charm]] cards level 0-4.
Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Word of Woe, Word of Weal, Deafening Silence, 1 random basic weakness.

cards.name: Word of Woe
cards.text:
Amina Zidane deck only.
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Place 1 doom on an asset you control to resolve an [action] ability on it, ignoring all costs (including its [action] cost). Then, if Word of Weal is in your discard pile, you may shuffle it into your deck.

cards.name: Word of Weal
cards.text:
Amina Zidane deck only.
Fast. Play when you perform a skill test on an asset with 1 or more doom on it.
Add your [willpower] to your skill value for this test. Then, if Word of Woe is in your discard pile, you may shuffle it into your deck.

cards.name: Deafening Silence
cards.text: Revelation - Move 1 doom from an asset you control to the current agenda. This may cause the current agenda to advance. If no doom is moved in this way, shuffle Deafening Silence back into your deck.

cards.name: Darrell Simmons
cards.text:
You begin the game with Darrell's Kodak in play.
[fast] During a skill test at your location, spend 1 evidence from an asset you control: Reduce the difficulty of this test by 2. (Limit once per test.)
[elder_sign] effect: +1. Place 1 evidence on an asset you control.
cards.backText:
Deck Size: 30.
Deckbuilding Options: Survivor cards ([survivor]) level 0-5, Seeker cards ([seeker]) level 0-2, Neutral cards level 0-5.
Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Darrell's Kodak, Ruined Film, 1 random basic weakness.

cards.name: Darrell's Kodak
cards.text:
Darrell Simmons deck only.
[reaction] After an enemy or treachery enters play, exhaust Darrell's Kodak: Place 1 resource (from the token pool) on that enemy or treachery, as evidence.
[reaction] After you discover any number of clues: Move that many evidence on enemies or treacheries at that location (or not at any location) to Darrell's Kodak.

cards.name: Ruined Film
cards.text: Revelation - Remove 4 evidence from cards you control. For each evidence you cannot remove in this way, take 1 horror.

cards.name: Charlie Kane
cards.text:
You have 3 additional ally slots.
[fast] During a skill test you are performing, exhaust an [[Ally]] asset you control: For this test, you get +1 skill value, plus an additional +1 for each skill icon that [[Ally]] asset has that matches this test's type.
[elder_sign] effect: +3. Ready an [[Ally]] asset at your location.
cards.backText:
Deck Size: 30.
Class Choices: At deck creation, choose 2 classes ([guardian], [seeker], [rogue], [mystic], or [survivor]).
Deckbuilding Options: [[Ally]] cards level 0-5, Neutral cards level 0-5, cards from your chosen classes level 0-2.
Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Bonnie Walsh, Burden of Leadership, 1 random basic weakness.

cards.name: Bonnie Walsh
cards.text:
Charlie Kane deck only.
[reaction] After you exhaust Bonnie Walsh: Ready another [[Ally]] asset you control. (Limit once per round.)

cards.name: Burden of Leadership
cards.text: Revelation - If you control no [[Ally]] assets, shuffle Burden of Leadership back into your deck. Otherwise, for each [[Ally]] asset you control, you must either exhaust it or deal it 1 direct damage and 1 direct horror.

cards.name: Hunter's Armor
cards.text: Customizable.

cards.name: Runic Axe
cards.text:
Customizable. Uses (4 charges). Replenish 1 of these charges at the start of each round.
[action]: Fight. You get +1 [combat] for this attack. Before this attack, you may spend any number of charges to imbue the axe with that many different inscriptions -
- Accuracy - You get an additional +2 [combat] for this attack.
- Power - This attack deals +1 damage.

cards.name: Custom Modifications
cards.text:
Customizable.
Attach to a [[Firearm]] asset you control. Limit 1 per asset.
[reaction] When you reveal a non-[auto_fail] chaos token attacking with attached asset, exhaust Custom Modifications: Cancel that chaos token, return it to the chaos bag, and reveal a new one.

cards.name: Obsidian Bracelet
cards.text:
Obsidian Bracelet may only be assigned damage and/or horror dealt by treachery effects.
Obsidian Bracelet may be assigned damage and/or horror dealt to other investigators at your location.

cards.name: Bolas
cards.text:
Evade. Attempt to evade using [combat] instead of [agility]. If you succeed and the enemy is non-[[Elite]], attach Bolas to it.
Attached enemy gets -1 evade value.
Forced - After attached enemy moves: Exhaust it.

cards.name: Breach the Door
cards.text:
Test [combat] (1). If you succeed, attach Breach the Door to your location with 1 resource on it for each point you succeeded by, as leads.
Reduce attached location's shroud by 1 for each lead on Breach the Door.

cards.name: Grievous Wound
cards.text:
Fast. Play after you successfully attack a non-[[Elite]] enemy using a [[Melee]] asset.
Attach Grievous Wound to the attacked enemy.
Forced - At the end of the round: Deal 1 damage to attached enemy.

cards.name: Motivational Speech
cards.text: Parley. Choose an investigator at your location. That investigator may play an [[Ally]] asset from their hand, reducing its cost by 3.

cards.name: One in the Chamber
cards.text:
Fast. Play at the end of an attack or effect that spends the last ammo from a [[Firearm]] asset you control.
Add 1 ammo to that asset. You get +3 skill value for your next attack with that asset this round.

cards.name: Fighting Lessons
cards.text:
Commit only to a skill test during an attack or evasion attempt.
You can commit this skill to an investigator's test at any location.

cards.name: Helping Hand
cards.text:
You may commit Helping Hand to any type of test. Max 1 committed per test.
While Helping Hand is committed to a skill test, double the skill icons of each other card committed to that test.

cards.name: Bestow Resolve
cards.text:
Uses (4 charges).
[fast] During a skill test performed by an investigator at your location or a connecting location, spend 1 charge: Commit a non-weakness card from your hand to that skill test, treating all of its skill icons as [wild].

cards.name: Field Agent
cards.text:
You get +1 [intellect].
[fast] Exhaust Field Agent and deal 1 horror to it: Discover 1 clue at your location.

cards.name: Guard Dog
cards.text:
[fast] Exhaust Guard Dog: Engage an enemy at your location. That enemy attacks you.
[reaction] When an enemy attack deals damage and/or horror to Guard Dog: Deal 1 damage to the attacking enemy.
Card design by the Council-in-Exile at Arkham Nights 2020.

cards.name: Handcuffs
cards.text:
Fast.
[action] If Handcuffs is not attached to an enemy: Evade. Use only on a [[Humanoid]] enemy. This evasion attempt uses [combat] instead of [agility]. If you succeed, remove all doom from the just-evaded enemy and attach Handcuffs to it.
If the attached enemy is non-[[Elite]], it cannot ready and doom cannot be placed on it.

cards.name: Prepared for the Worst
cards.text: Choose an investigator at your location. That investigator search the top 9 cards of their deck for a [[Weapon]] asset, adds it to their hand or plays it (paying its resource cost), and shuffles their deck.

cards.name: Martyr's Vambrace
cards.text:
You get +1 skill value while resolving revelation abilities on encounter cards.
[reaction] After another investigator at your location draws a non-peril encounter card, before resolving that card's effects, exhaust Martyr's Vambrace: You are considered to have drawn that encounter card, instead.

cards.name: Girish Kadakia
cards.text:
Girish Kadakia may be assigned damage and/or horror dealt to other investigators at your location.
[fast] During a skill test being performed by an investigator at your location, exhaust Girish Kadakia: That investigator gets +2 skill value for this test. If this test is successful, heal 1 damage or horror from Girish Kadakia.

cards.name: Ever Vigilant
cards.text: One at a time, investigators at your location, as a group, may play up to 4 assets in total from their hands, reducing the resource cost of each by 1.

cards.name: Alchemical Distillation
cards.text:
Customizable. Uses (3 supplies).
[action] Spend 1 supply: Choose an investigator at your location and test [intellect] (1). If you succeed, that investigator performs one of the following options -
- Draw 2 cards.
- Gain 2 resources.

cards.name: Empirical Hypothesis
cards.text:
Customizable. Limit 1 per investigator.
Forced - At the start of the round: Choose one of the following criteria for this round
- You fail a test by 2 or more.
- You succeed at a test by 3 or more.
When the chosen criteria is met, you may exhaust Empirical Hypothesis to add 1 evidence to it.
[fast] Spend 1 evidence: Draw 1 card.

cards.name: The Raven Quill
cards.text:
Customizable. When you purchase The Raven Quill, name a [[Tome]] or [[Spell]] asset and record that name on its upgrade sheet.
Attach to a named asset you control.
[reaction] When you resign or the game ends: Either mark a checkbox on The Raven Quill's upgrade sheet, or reduce the experience cost to upgrade the attached asset before the next scenario by 1.

cards.name: Dissection Tools
cards.text:
[reaction] After an enemy at your location is defeated: Place 1 resource (from the token pool) on this card, as evidence.
While Dissection Tools has...
- ... 1 or more evidence, you get +1 [agility].
- ... 2 or more evidence, you get +1 [combat].
- ... 3 or more evidence, you get +1 sanity.

cards.name: Grim Memoir
cards.text:
Uses (4 secrets).
[action] Spend 1 secret: Investigate. You get +2 [intellect] for this investigation. If you succeed by 2 or more, you may draw 1 card.

cards.name: Research Notes
cards.text:
[reaction] After a player card ability places 1 or more of your clues on your location: Place that many resources on Research Notes, as evidence.
[action]: Test [intellect] (0). For each point you succeed by, you may spend 1 evidence to discover 1 clue at your location.

cards.name: Bizarre Diagnosis
cards.text: Place 1 of your clues on your location. Then, heal 3 damage from an investigator or [[Ally]] asset at your location.

cards.name: Captivating Discovery
cards.text: Search the top 6 cards of your deck. You may place up to 3 of your clues on your location. For each clue placed in this way, choose and add 2 of the searched cards to your hand. Shuffle your deck.

cards.name: Map the Area
cards.text:
Investigate. Add your [willpower] or [agility] to your skill value for this investigation. If you succeed, instead of discovering clues at this location, attach Map the Area to it. Limit 1 per location.
Reduce the difficulty of all skill tests at attached location by 1.

cards.name: Analysis
cards.text: After revealing a chaos token for this skill test, you may place 1 of your clues on your location to cancel that chaos token, return it to the chaos bag, and reveal a new one. (You may do this any number of times.)

cards.name: Lab Coat
cards.text: [reaction] When you would fail a skill test on a [seeker] card by 1 or less, exhaust Lab Coat: You succeed by 0, instead.

cards.name: Orphic Theory
cards.text:
Uses (4 secrets).
[fast] Spend 1 secret: Choose any non-weakness treachery not attached to an [[Elite]] enemy. Until the end of the round, treat that card's printed text box as if it were blank (except for [[Traits]]).

cards.name: Existential Riddle
cards.text:
Parley. Choose a non-[[Elite]] enemy at your location and test [willpower] or [intellect] (8). This test gets -1 difficulty for each other card in your hand. If you succeed, automatically evade the chosen enemy and attach Existential Riddle to it.
Attached enemy gains aloof.

cards.name: Guidance
cards.text: Choose another investigator at your location who has yet to take their turn this round. During their turn this round, the chosen investigator gets +1 to each of their skills, and may take an additional action. Playing Guidance does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

cards.name: Dr. William T. Maleson
cards.text: [reaction] When any investigator draws an encounter card from the encounter deck, exhaust Dr. William T. Maleson and place 1 of your clues on your location: That investigator draws another card from the top of the encounter deck, chooses one of those 2 cards to resolve, and cancels and discards the other.

cards.name: Press Pass
cards.text: [reaction] After you spend 1 or more clues or place 1 or more clues on your location, exhaust Press Pass: You may take an additional action during this turn (or your next turn if it is not currently your turn).

cards.name: Surgical Kit
cards.text:
Uses (4 supplies).
[reaction] When one of your card effects heals damage from an investigator, spend 1 supply: Either that effect heals 1 additional damage, or you draw 1 card and heal 1 horror.
[action] [action]: Heal 3 damage from an investigator or [[Ally]] asset at your location.

cards.name: Fingerprint Kit
cards.text:
Uses (3 supplies).
[action] Exhaust Fingerprint Kit and spend 1 supply: Investigate. You get +2 [intellect] for this investigation. If you succeed, you discover 2 additional clues at your location.

cards.name: Gray's Anatomy
cards.text:
[action]: Choose a card at your location and test [intellect] (1). For each point you succeed by, choose one -
- The next time that card would be healed this round, heal +1 damage/horror (to a maximum of +3).
- The next time that card would be dealt damage this round, deal +1 damage (to a maximum of +3).

cards.name: Damning Testimony
cards.text:
Customizable. Uses (3 evidence).
[action] Exhaust Damning Testimony and choose an enemy at any location: Investigate (your location). If you succeed, you may spend 1 evidence to discover 1 additional clue at the chosen enemy's location.

cards.name: Friends in Low Places
cards.text:
Customizable. When you purchase Friends in Low Places, choose and record a [[Trait]] on its upgrade sheet.
Look at the top 6 cards of your deck. For each looked-at card with the chosen [[Trait]](s), you may spend 1 resource to add that card to your hand. Shuffle the remaining cards into your deck.

cards.name: Honed Instinct
cards.text:
Customizable. Fast. Play this card only after one of the following conditions is met:
- The agenda or act advances.
- You succeed at a skill test by 3 or more.
Immediately take an action as if it were your turn. (Max once per round.)

cards.name: Disguise
cards.text:
Uses (4 supplies).
[action] Spend 1 supply: Evade. You get +2 [agility] for this evasion attempt. If you succeed and the evaded enemy is non-[[Elite]], it does not ready during the next upkeep phase.

cards.name: Embezzled Treasure
cards.text:
[fast] Exhaust Embezzled Treasure: Move up to 2 resources from your resource pool to Embezzled Treasure (to a maximum of 10 resources on it).
Forced - When you resign or the game ends: For every 2 resources on Embezzled Treasure, an investigator of your choice begins the next scenario of the campaign with 1 additional resource in their resource pool.

cards.name: Thieves' Kit
cards.text:
Uses (6 supplies).
[action] Spend 1 supply: Investigate. You may use [agility] instead of [intellect] for this investigation. If you succeed, gain 1 resource.

cards.name: Hidden Pocket
cards.text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Attach to a [[Clothing]] or [[Armor]] asset you control.
Attached asset gains: "You have 1 additional hand or accessory slot (your choice), which can only be used to hold an [[Illicit]] asset."

cards.name: Hit and Run
cards.text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Put an [[Ally]] asset from your hand into play. At the end of your turn, if that asset is still in play, return it to your hand.

cards.name: "I'll take that!"
cards.text:
Fast. Play when you successfully evade a [[Humanoid]] enemy or successfully investigate.
Play an [[Item]] asset from your hand, reducing its cost by X, where X is the amount you succeeded by. Attach "I'll take that!" to that asset. Attached asset gains [[Illicit]].

cards.name: Kicking the Hornet's Nest
cards.text: Search the top 9 cards of the encounter deck for a non-[[Elite]] enemy and spawn it engaged with you (instead of its normal spawn location). Then, discover 1 clue at your location and gain X resources, where X is that enemy's health value. Shuffle the encounter deck.

cards.name: Quick Getaway
cards.text:
Fast. Play when an enemy attacks you.
Evade. Attempt to evade the attacking enemy. If you succeed, cancel that enemy's attack.

cards.name: Calculated Risk
cards.text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
Commit only to a test you are performing of any type, and only if it is your turn.
Calculated Risk gains [wild] for each action you performed this turn (including this one).
After this test ends, end your turn.

cards.name: Stylish Coat
cards.text: [reaction] When you gain 1 or more resources during your turn via another player card effect, exhaust Stylish Coat: Gain 1 additional resource.

cards.name: Chuck Fergus
cards.text:
[reaction] When you play a [[Tactic]] or [[Trick]] event, exhaust Chuck Fergus: Choose one -
- That event gains fast.
- That event costs 2 fewer resources to play.
- You get +2 skill value while performing a skill test during the resolution of that event.

cards.name: Dirty Fighting
cards.text:
Limit 1 per investigator.
While attacking, parleying, or attempting to evade an exhausted enemy, you get +2 skill value.
[reaction] After you evade an enemy, exhaust Dirty Fighting: Take a fight action against that enemy. Ignore the aloof keyword for this attack.

cards.name: Breaking and Entering
cards.text: Investigate. Add your [agility] value to your skill value for this investigation. If you succeed by 1 or more, you may automatically evade an enemy at this location. If you succeed by 3 or more, return Breaking and Entering to your hand at the end of your turn. This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

cards.name: Thieves' Kit
cards.text:
Uses (6 supplies).
[action] Spend 1 supply: Investigate. For this investigation, you may use [agility] instead of [intellect], and you get +1 skill value. If you succeed, gain 1 resource (2 resources instead if you succeed by 2 or more).

cards.name: Trigger Man
cards.text:
[reaction] After Trigger Man enters play: Attach an [[Illicit]] asset from your hand to Trigger Man (it is considered to be in play and under your control).
[fast] Exhaust Trigger Man and spend 1 resource: Resolve an [action] ability on attached asset, without paying its [action] cost. Resolve that ability with a base skill value of 4.

cards.name: Underworld Market
cards.text:
Permanent. Exceptional. You get +10 deck size.
[reaction] Before drawing your opening hand, choose 10 [[Illicit]] cards from your deck: Shuffle them together and place them next to Underworld Market, as your market deck.
[reaction] At the start of your turn: Reveal the top 2 cards of your market deck. You may spend 1 resource to draw 1 of them. Place the rest on the bottom, in any order.

cards.name: Clean Sneak
cards.text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
For each exhausted non-swarm enemy at your location, choose a different option:
- Gain 2 resources.
- Deal 2 damage to that enemy.
- Discover 1 clue at your location.
- Draw 1 card.

cards.name: Living Ink
cards.text:
Customizable. When you purchase Living Ink, choose a skill and circle it on its upgrade sheet.
Uses (3 charges).
Remove 1 charge from Living Ink at the start of each of your turns. If Living Ink has no charges, discard it.
You get +1 to the chosen skill(s).

cards.name: Summoned Servitor
cards.text:
Customizable. As an additional cost to play Summoned Servitor, you must discard another asset you control.
Summoned Servitor enters play at your location. It can take 1 action during each of your turns, which can only be used to take the following action:
- Move Summoned Servitor to a connecting revealed location.

cards.name: Power Word
cards.text:
Customizable. Fast. Play only during your turn.
Attach to a non-[[Elite]] enemy at your location.
[action] If attached enemy is at your location: Parley. Give it a command (limit once per round per command) -
- "Go." This enemy moves once in a direction of your choice.
- "Cower." This enemy exhausts.

cards.name: Ceremonial Sickle
cards.text:
[action]: Fight. Either use your [willpower] or get +1 [combat] for this attack. When you initiate this ability, choose one -
- Exhaust Ceremonial Sickle and place 1 doom on it to get +1 skill value and deal +1 damage for this attack.
- If this attack defeats an enemy, remove 1 doom from Ceremonial Sickle.

cards.name: Dowsing Rod
cards.text:
[action]: Investigate. Either use your [willpower] or get +1 [intellect] for this investigation. When you initiate this ability, choose one -
- Exhaust Dowsing Rod and place 1 doom on it to move to a connecting location.
- If this investigation discovers the last clue at a location, remove 1 doom from Dowsing Rod.

cards.name: Hallowed Chalice
cards.text:
[action]: Choose an investigator at your location and either (choose one) -
- Exhaust Hallowed Chalice and place 1 doom on it to heal 2 damage or 2 horror from that investigator.
- Heal 1 damage or 1 horror from that investigator. If you heal the last damage or horror from that investigator, remove 1 doom from Hallowed Chalice.

cards.name: Onyx Pentacle
cards.text:
[action]: Evade. Either use your [willpower] or get +1 [agility] for this evasion attempt. When you initiate this ability, choose one -
- Exhaust Onyx Pentacle and place 1 doom on it to target any enemy at your location or a connecting location, and get +1 skill value for this evasion attempt.
- If you succeed by 2 or more, remove 1 doom from Onyx Pentacle.

cards.name: Eldritch Initiation
cards.text: For each arcane slot you have, draw 1 card (max 5). For each filled arcane slot you have, choose and discard 1 card from your hand.

cards.name: Explosive Ward
cards.text:
Before you play Explosive Ward, you may discard any number of cards from your arcane slots.
Deal X damage to a non-[[Elite]] enemy engaged with you. X cannot be greater than the number of empty arcane slots you have. This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

cards.name: String of Curses
cards.text:
Parley. Choose a non-[[Elite]] enemy at your location and either (choose one):
- Automatically evade that enemy and place 1 doom on it. It cannot take damage for the remainder of the round. Discover 1 clue at your location.
- If that enemy has 1 or more doom on it, defeat it. Gain 1 resource for each doom that was on it.

cards.name: Binder's Jar
cards.text:
You get +1 arcane slot for each enemy beneath Binder's Jar.
[reaction] After a non-[[Elite]] enemy is defeated at your location: Place that enemy facedown beneath Binder's Jar (limit 2 enemies beneath it).
[reaction] When an enemy attacks you, discard an enemy beneath Binder's Jar that shares a [[Trait]] with the attacking enemy: Cancel that attack.

cards.name: Ghastly Possession
cards.text:
After you commit Ghastly Possession to a skill test on an asset, choose one:
- Place 1 doom on that asset. Ghastly Possession gains [wild][wild].
- If this test is successful, either remove 1 doom from this asset, or replenish half of its uses (rounded down).

cards.name: Astral Mirror
cards.text:
For each of your arcane slots that are empty, you have one additional hand slot.
You may take an additional action during your turn, which can only be used to play an asset into one of your hand slots.

cards.name: Elle Rubash
cards.text:
You get +1 skill value while resolving a skill test on an attached asset.
1 doom on each attached asset does not count towards the agenda's doom threshold.
[fast] Exhaust Elle Rubash: Choose an asset in your play area with 1 or more doom on it. Attach it to Elle Rubash, or switch it with an attached asset. (Limit 2 attached assets).

cards.name: Moonlight Ritual
cards.text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Remove all doom from a non-[[Elite]] card at your location.

cards.name: Sin-Eater
cards.text:
Permanent. Exceptional.
[fast] Exhaust Sin-Eater: Move 1 doom from an asset you control to Sin-Eater. Then, either ready that asset or place 1 charge on it.
[action]: Remove all doom from Sin-Eater.

cards.name: Uncage the Soul

"It is the spirit of a girl. She watched many stories unfold in this very theater," says Melati. The shadow on the screen forms a hungry smile filled with sharp teeth that turns to a fearful frown. "She is loathe to let go of this place, for she does not know if her story will continue." As Melati translates, you assure the spirit that you have looked beyond the veil and she can leave this plane of existence. As the hoary shadows dissipate, you feel a coldness as you reflect on what you saw - and didn't see - in the beyond. Was it wrong to reassure her?

Tzu San Niang's heartless business separated the workers from their families. And now, they will never be reunited, except in death."
She holds the tin figurine over the surface of the water and lets go of it. You think you can see the outline of wispy, spectral hands grasping at it as it sinks to the bottom of the pit.

Revelation - If there are no [[Coterie]] enemies in play, Bound in Red gains surge. Otherwise, attach it to the [[Coterie]] enemy with the highest printed health.
Attached enemy gets +1 fight, +1 evade, +1 damage, and +1 horror.
[action]: Flip a [[Stable]] key you control to its [[Unstable]] side. Then, discard Bound in Red. An investigator at any location may trigger this ability.

cards.name: Key Charge
cards.text:
Surge.
Revelation - Each [[Coterie]] enemy shifts each key attached to it.

cards.name: Paracausal Entity
cards.text:
Hunter.
Forced - When Paracausal Entity engages you: Look at the top card of your deck. If it is not a weakness, set it aside, out of play, as a hollow.

cards.name: Apocalyptic Presage
cards.text:
Forced - When Apocalyptic Presage enters play: Each investigator chooses a non-weakness card they control in their hand or play area and sets it aside, out of play, as a hollow.
[reaction] When Apocalyptic Presage is defeated: Instead of adding it to the victory display, discard it and choose up to 3 set-aside hollows. Add them to their owners' hands.

cards.name: Substance Dissimulation
cards.text: Revelation - For each set-aside hollow you own, if there are 1 or more copies of that hollow in your play area and/or hand, discard those copies and take 1 damage and 1 horror. If no cards are discarded by this effect, choose a non-weakness card you control in your hand or play area and set it aside, out of play, as a hollow.

cards.name: Otherworldly Mimic
cards.text:
Aloof. Hunter.
Forced - If Otherworldly Mimic is ready, when an investigator at its location plays, commits, or triggers an ability on a copy of a set-aside hollow: It attacks that investigator.

cards.name: Memory Variant
cards.text:
Revelation - Put Memory Variant into play next to the agenda deck.
Forced - After an event is played: Instead of discarding it, set it aside, out of play, as a hollow.
[action]: Test [willpower] (4). If you succeed, discard Memory Variant. Any investigator may trigger this ability.

cards.name: Secrets Lost
cards.text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). For each point you fail by, choose a non-weakness card in your hand and set it aside, out of play, as a hollow. If you succeed by 2 or more, you may take 1 horror to choose a set-aside hollow and add it to its owner's hand.

cards.name: Paradigm Effacer
cards.text:
Aloof. Hunter.
Forced - After you end your turn at Paradigm Effacer's location: Look at the top card of your deck. If it is not a weakness, set it aside, out of play, as a hollow. Then, if you own 3 or more set-aside hollows, Paradigm Effacer attacks you.

cards.name: Matter Inversion
cards.text:
Revelation - Attach to an [[Outsider]] enemy without a copy of Matter Inversion attached. If you cannot, Matter Inversion gains surge.
Attached enemy loses aloof, gains retaliate, and gets +1 fight and +1 evade.
Forced - After attached enemy is successfully evaded: Discard Matter Inversion and draw 1 of your set-aside hollows.

cards.name: Emissary from Yuggoth
cards.text:
Concealed 2. Hunter. Massive.
Forced - After you discover a clue at a location with 1 or more concealed mini-cards, if Emissary from Yuggoth is in the shadows: It attacks you.

cards.name: Tenebrous Eclipse
cards.text:
Revelation - Put Tenebrous Eclipse into play next to the agenda deck.
No more than 1 concealed mini-card can be exposed by each investigator each round.
Forced - At the end of the round: Discard 1 copy of Tenebrous Eclipse from play. (Max once per round.)

cards.name: Splintered Space
cards.text: Revelation - Attach Splintered Space to your location and test [agility] (3). If you fail, take 1 damage for each [[Hex]] treachery attached to your location. After this test ends, if there are exactly 3 copies of Splintered Space in play, discard them.

cards.name: Beyond the Pale
cards.text: Revelation - Attach Beyond the Pale to your location and test [willpower] (3). If you fail, take 1 horror for each [[Hex]] treachery attached to your location. After this test ends, if there are exactly 3 copies of Beyond the Pale in play, discard them.

cards.name: Warped Reality
cards.text:
Revelation - Attach to your location.
Forced - After you end your turn at attached location: Choose a non-weakness card in your hand and set it aside, out of play, as a hollow.
[action][action]: Discard Warped Reality.

cards.name: Touch of the Beyond
cards.text: Revelation - Place 1 doom on the asset you control with the highest printed resource cost. If no doom was placed by this effect, Touch of the Beyond gains surge.

cards.name: Compulsion
cards.text:
Revelation - Put Compulsion into play in your threat area.
Forced - When your turn begins: Reveal a random chaos token from the chaos bag. If it is a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], or [elder_thing] token, the first action you perform during this turn must be the below ability, if able.
[action][action]: Discard Compulsion.

cards.name: Distorted Reasoning
cards.text:
Revelation - Put Distorted Reasoning into play in your threat area.
You cannot perform the same type of action twice in a row. (Types include activate, engage, evade, fight, investigate, move, play, resource, and draw.)
Forced - At the end of your turn: Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, discard Distorted Reasoning.

- If it is in the right position in the shadows, take 1 horror.

cards.name: Paradimensional Terror
cards.text:
Peril.
Revelation - You must decide (choose one):
- Flip each decoy over. Shuffle all concealed mini-cards in play, then place them facedown at random in the positions they were in.
- Each investigator takes 1 damage and 1 horror.

cards.name: The Red-Gloved Man
cards.text:
Retaliate.
Forced - After you flip a key from its [[Unstable]] side to its [[Stable]] side: The Red-Gloved Man attacks you. Then, the Red-Gloved Man shifts each of his attached keys.

cards.name: La Chica Roja
cards.text:
Aloof.
Spawn - Location farthest from you.
Forced - At the end of the enemy phase, if La Chica Roja is unengaged: Move 1 resource from each investigator to her. She shifts each of her attached keys.
[reaction] After La Chica Roja is defeated: Distribute her resources among the investigators, as you wish.

cards.name: The Sanguine Watcher
cards.text:
Hunter.
Forced - When you defeat The Sanguine Watcher: He shifts each of his attached keys twice.

cards.name: The Beast in a Cowl of Crimson
cards.text:
Hunter.
Spawn - Location farthest from you.
Forced - After you fail a skill test while at The Beast in a Cowl of Crimson's location, if it is ready: It shifts each of its attached keys.

cards.name: The Claret Knight
cards.text:
Spawn - Location farthest from you.
Each other [[Coterie]] enemy gets +2 fight.
Forced - After another [[Coterie]] enemy is discarded from play: The Claret Knight shifts each of his attached keys.

cards.name: Thorne
cards.text:
Hunter.
Forced - After Thorne enters play: They shift each of their attached keys.
[fast] Choose a key attached to your investigator and remove it from the game: Add Thorne to the victory display. Thorne is now the bearer of the chosen key. (Update the Campaign Log.)

cards.name: Desiderio Delgado Álvarez
cards.nameZh: 德西德柔·戴佳多·欧瓦瑞兹
cards.text:
Patrol (nearest location with at least one other [[Coterie]] enemy).
Forced - When another [[Coterie]] enemy at Desiderio Delgado Álvarez's location would take 1 or more damage: Deal that damage to him, instead. Then, he shifts each of his attached keys.

cards.name: Amaranth
cards.text:
Hunter.
Forced - When Amaranth attacks: She shifts each of her attached keys. If damage and/or horror from this attack is assigned to an asset, defeat that asset.

cards.name: Tzu San Niang
cards.text:
Hunter. Retaliate.
Forced - When you succeed at a skill test by 2 or more while fighting or attempting to evade Tzu San Niang: She shifts each of her attached keys.

cards.name: Aliki Zoni Uperetria
cards.nameZh: 艾里奇·佐尼·奥佩勒曲亚

Aloof.
Forced - At the end of the enemy phase: Each investigator looks at the top card of their deck. Set each non-weakness card looked at in this way aside, out of play, as a hollow. If there is already a copy of that card set aside as a hollow, Aliki Zoni Uperetria shifts each of her attached keys.

cards.name: Inspector Flint
cards.text: [reaction] When you expose a decoy, exhaust Inspector Flint: Cancel the exposing of that decoy, flip it facedown and either draw 1 card or choose a different concealed mini-card at that location to expose.

cards.name: Agent Ari Quinn
cards.text:
While there is a concealed mini-card at your location, you get +1 [intellect], +1 [combat], and +1 [agility].
[reaction] After you expose a card in the shadows, exhaust Agent Ari Quinn: Draw 1 card.

cards.name: Dr. Dewi Irawan
cards.text:
You get +1 [willpower].
[fast] Exhaust Dr. Dewi Irawan: Either reveal a card from your hand to shuffle each copy of that card that is set-aside as a hollow into its owner's deck, or discard a card from your hand to shuffle any set-aside hollow into its owner's deck. In either case, gain 1 resource for each card shuffled in this way.

cards.name: Expedited Ticket
cards.text:
Permanent.
While embarking to a new destination on the map, you may exile Expedited Ticket and mark 1 time in your Campaign Log to travel anywhere on the map.

promptCard.name: Riddles and Rain
promptCard.text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -1 (-3 instead if you have 2 or more clues).
[tablet]: -1. If there is a concealed mini-card at your location, reveal another chaos token.
[elder_thing]: -3. If you fail, you must either spend 1 clue or place 1 doom on an enemy in the shadows.
promptCard.backText:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -2 (-4 instead if you have 2 or more clues).
[tablet]: -2. If there is a concealed mini-card at your location, reveal another chaos token.
[elder_thing]: -4. If you fail, you must either spend 1 clue or place 1 doom on an enemy in the shadows.

promptCard.name: Dead Heat
promptCard.text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -1 for every 1 [per_investigator] civilians slain.
[cultist]: -4. If you fail, choose a non-[[Elite]] enemy at your location. That enemy readies and attacks you.
[tablet]: -1. You may take 1 damage. If you do not, a civilian at your location is slain.
[elder_thing]: -3. If you fail, choose and discard 1 card from your hand.
promptCard.backText:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -2 for every 1 [per_investigator] civilians slain.
[cultist]: -6. Choose a non-[[Elite]] enemy at your location. That enemy readies and attacks you.
[tablet]: -2. Take 1 damage. A civilian at your location is slain.
[elder_thing]: -4. If you fail, discard 1 card from your hand at random.

promptCard.name: Sanguine Shadows
promptCard.text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is the number of targets on this card.
[cultist]: -5. If you fail by 2 or more, shuffle each concealed mini-card at your location and at each connecting location facedown, then place them at random in the positions they were in.
[tablet]: -1. Cancel the effects and icons of each card committed to this skill test.
[elder_thing]: -2. If you fail, you must either place 1 doom on the current agenda, or the nearest [[Coterie]] enemy attacks you (even if it is in the shadows).
promptCard.backText:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -X. X is 1 more than the number of targets on this card.
[cultist]: -7. If you fail by 2 or more, shuffle each concealed mini-card at your location and at each connecting location facedown, then place them at random in the positions they were in.
[tablet]: -2. Cancel the effects and icons of each card committed to this skill test.
[elder_thing]: -3. If you fail, you must either place 1 doom on the current agenda, or the nearest [[Coterie]] enemy attacks you (even if it is in the shadows).

promptCard.name: Dealings in the Dark
promptCard.text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is the highest number of clues on a [[Cultist]] enemy in play, to a maximum of 3. (If it is act 3, X is 3.)
[cultist]: -5. You may place 1 doom on the nearest [[Cultist]] enemy to change this token's modifier to -1.
[tablet]: -3. If you fail, place 1 of your clues on your location.
[elder_thing]: -2. If you fail, place 1 doom on the nearest [[Cultist]] enemy.
promptCard.backText:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -X. X is the total number of clues on [[Cultist]] enemies in play, to a maximum of 4. (If it is act 3, X is 4.)
[cultist]: -7. You may place 1 doom on the nearest [[Cultist]] enemy to change this token's modifier to -3.
[tablet]: -4. If you fail, place 1 of your clues on your location.
[elder_thing]: -2. Place 1 doom on the nearest [[Cultist]] enemy.

promptCard.name: Dancing Mad
promptCard.text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is the number of enemies in the shadows (max 3).
[cultist]: -4. If you fail, put a decoy into play at your location, flip it over, and shuffle each concealed mini-card at your location facedown.
[tablet]: -3. If you fail, set each non-weakness card committed to this test aside, out of play, as a hollow.
[elder_thing]: -1. If there is a concealed mini-card at your location, either take 1 damage or treat this token's modifier as -3.
promptCard.backText:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -X. X is the number of enemies in the shadows (max 5).
[cultist]: -6. If you fail, put a decoy into play at your location, flip it over, and shuffle each concealed mini-card at your location facedown.
[tablet]: -3. Set each non-weakness card committed to this test aside, out of play, as a hollow.
[elder_thing]: -1. If there is a concealed mini-card at your location, either take 2 damage or treat this token's modifier as -5.

promptCard.name: On Thin Ice
promptCard.text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is the number of [[Hazard]] treacheries in play.
[cultist]: -4. If you fail, choose a non-weakness card in your hand and set it aside, out of play, as a hollow.
[tablet]: -2 (-5 instead if Void Chimera is at your location).
[elder_thing]: -3. If you fail, look at the top card of your deck. If it is not a weakness, set it aside, out of play, as a hollow.
promptCard.backText:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -X. X is 1 more than the number of [[Hazard]] treacheries in play.
[cultist]: -5. Choose a non-weakness card in your hand and set it aside, out of play, as a hollow.
[tablet]: -3. If Void Chimera is at your location, you automatically fail, instead.
[elder_thing]: -4. Look at the top card of your deck. If it is not a weakness, set it aside, out of play, as a hollow.

promptCard.name: Dogs of War
promptCard.text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -1 (-3 instead if you are at a location with a Key Locus).
[cultist]: -3. If you fail, either take 1 damage and 1 horror, or place 1 doom on the nearest Key Locus or [[Locus Site]] location.
[tablet]: -2. If this is an attack against an enemy with patrol, after this attack, it disengages and resolves its patrol keyword.
[elder_thing]: -2. For each point you fail by, lose 1 resource (max 3).
promptCard.backText:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -2 (-4 instead if you are at a location with a Key Locus).
[cultist]: -5. If you fail, either take 1 damage and 1 horror, or place 1 doom on the nearest Key Locus or [[Locus Site]] location.
[tablet]: -2. If this is an attack against an enemy with patrol, after this attack, it attacks you, disengages, and resolves its patrol keyword.
[elder_thing]: -3. For each point you fail by, lose 1 resource.

promptCard.name: Shades of Suffering
promptCard.text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is half the number of charges on The Shade Reaper, rounded up (X cannot be greater than 6).
[cultist]: -4. If you fail by 2 or more, place 1 charge on The Shade Reaper.
[tablet]: -1. If you are at a location with a [[Geist]] enemy, reveal an additional chaos token.
[elder_thing]: -4. You may place 1 charge on The Shade Reaper to treat this token's modifier as 0 instead.
promptCard.backText:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -X. X is the number of charges on The Shade Reaper.
[cultist]: -5. Place 1 charge on The Shade Reaper.
[tablet]: -3. If you are at a location with a [[Geist]] enemy, you automatically fail.
[elder_thing]: -6. You may place 1 charge on The Shade Reaper to treat this token's modifier as -3 instead.

promptCard.name: Without a Trace
promptCard.text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is half the number of locations in play, rounded down.
[cultist]: -4. If you fail, the nearest [[Outsider]] enemy readies, moves once toward you, and attacks you if it is at your location.
[tablet]: -X. X is the number of set-aside hollows you own (max 5).
[elder_thing]: -3. If you fail, choose a non-weakness card in your hand and set it aside, as a hollow.
promptCard.backText:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -X. X is the number of locations in play.
[cultist]: -6. If you fail, the nearest [[Outsider]] enemy readies, moves once toward you, and attacks you if it is at your location.
[tablet]: -X. X is 1 plus the number of set-aside hollows you own.
[elder_thing]: -3. Choose a non-weakness card in your hand and set it aside, as a hollow.

promptCard.name: Congress of the Keys

[skull]: -X. X is the current act number.
[cultist]: -5. You may flip a [[Stable]] key you control to its [[Unstable]] side to treat this token's modifier as -2, instead.
[tablet]: -2. If this is an attack against a ready [[Outsider]] enemy, you automatically fail, instead.
[elder_thing]: -3. Cancel the effects and icons of each card committed to this test and set each of them aside, out of play, as hollows.
promptCard.backText:

[elder_thing]: -4. Cancel the effects and icons of each card committed to this test and set each of them aside, out of play, as hollows.
